latest.title: Mainstream and sidestream capnography give different ETCO2
latest.finding: Mainstream ETCO2 bias +3.94 mmHg vs sidestream (limits of agreement -3.21 to 11.09 mmHg, proportional bias 0.0746); trends matched (-1.44 vs -1.41 mmHg/min, p=0.93); abrupt rises >=10 mmHg co-detected in 7/8 and drops in 10/15

latest.title: Community first responders trained but rarely dispatched
latest.finding: 84.3% had CPR training within two years and 97.3% felt prepared (both associated with healthcare/emergency background and recent training, p<0.001), yet only 15.1% had ever been dispatched, 2.8% arrived before EMS and 1.9% performed CPR

latest.title: Mapping chest pain risk tools in ambulance care
latest.finding: Eight chest-pain risk-stratification tools were used or trialled in ambulance settings; HEART and its derivatives were the most frequently studied, with performance varying across settings and validation for ambulance use incomplete

latest.title: AI in cardiac arrest: oversight may be symbolic
latest.finding: No empirical data — proposes five policy measures including ecological trialling, designed-in explainability, defined escalation triggers and authority, and protection for justified deviation from AI recommendations
